question: Lemon juice contains ________ which when mixed with baking soda reacts to form carbon dioxide and sodium citrate causing the liquid to fizz and bubble.
solution:
The correct answer is __**citric acid.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lemon juice contains Citric Acid which when mixed with baking soda reacts to form carbon dioxide and sodium citrate causing the liquid to fizz and bubble.**
 
• An** organic compound** with the** chemical formula HOC(CH₂CO₂H)₂.**
 
• **colourless weak organic acid**.
 
• occurs** naturally in citrus fruits**. 
 
• It is used widely as an **acidifier, a flavouring, and a chelating agent.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** Acetic acid

 
• Also known as **ethanoic acid, ethylic acid, vinegar acid, and methane carboxylic acid.**
 
• Chemical formula: **CH3COOH.**
 
• It is a** byproduct of fermentation** and** gives vinegar its characteristic odour**.
 
• Vinegar is about **4-6% acetic acid **in water.

**Formic acid**

 
• **The simplest carboxylic acid contains a single carbon.**
 
• **Chemical Formula: **HCOOH
 
• Occurs naturally in the venom of bee and ant stings.
 
• Useful** organic synthetic reagent.**
 
• Principally used as a **preservative and antibacterial agent in livestock feed.**

**Tartaric Acid**

 
• A **white, crystalline organic acid.**
 
• **Chemical Formula: **C4H6O6
 
• occurs naturally in **many fruits, most notably in grapes, bananas, tamarinds, and citrus**.
 
• Its salt:** potassium bitartrate, commonly known as cream of tartar,** develops naturally in the **process of fermentation.**
